Container.Name: termin
Container.Overview: Remote CalDAV MCP server for Claude (claude.ai, Desktop, Code). Streamable HTTP with built-in OAuth 2.1. Needs a public HTTPS URL through your reverse proxy or a tunnel.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: HTTP port. Your reverse proxy terminates TLS and forwards here.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database, Data Protection keys, optional termin.yaml.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Public HTTPS URL without a trailing slash, e.g. https://termin.merz.tools. Must match what you enter in claude.ai.

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: Base64 32-byte key that encrypts CalDAV passwords. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32. Changing it makes stored accounts unreadable.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password for /setup and the OAuth consent page.

Config.Name: Default timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone used for new events and floating times.

Config.Name: Static token
Config.Description: Optional fixed bearer token for Claude Code and scripts. Leave empty for OAuth only.

Config.Name: Metrics
Config.Description: Set to 1 to expose Prometheus metrics on /metrics. Block it at the proxy.
